comment: Monster and NPC behaviour, read by src/engine/actors/brains.ts and crates/engine/src/ai.rs. A brain is a small state machine: each state does one thing (act) for a number of frames, then goes to `next` - a state name, or guards picked in order ({ if, to }, the last usually without an if). `interrupt` guards are checked every frame and cut a state short. Acts: wait, advance (along the gait, toward: wander | player | away | keep | caller | ally | group), windup (pick where a slam lands), leap (jump there and slam), channel (gather the pack in). Conditions: called, angry, threatened, canCall, slam, allies, callOver, broken, fuseLow. Distances are metres, times are sim frames (60 per second).
